note: Facets are multi-valued. A record may hold any number of values in each dimension. Values marked extension extend the base vocabulary requested for FORM; they are first-class and searchable.

dimensions.label: Used for
dimensions.question: What job does it do on a page?

values.hero: The first composition a visitor sees; sets the tone of the page.
values.background: A surface or atmosphere that sits behind content.
values.navigation: Moves people between places, sections or views.
values.selection: Choosing one or more options, values or modes.
values.cta: A call to action that asks for one decisive click.
values.menu: A set of commands or links revealed on demand.
values.card: A bounded object that represents one item.
values.gallery: Browsing a set of images, projects or objects.
values.media: Presenting images, video, audio or camera feeds.
values.loading: Covering a wait, from milliseconds to minutes.
values.state-change: Communicating that something switched: theme, mode, status.
values.storytelling: Sequencing content so it reads as a narrative.
values.diagram: Explaining a system, relationship or process visually.
values.footer: The closing section of a page.
values.decoration: Ornament that carries mood, not information.
values.onboarding: Teaching a first-time visitor where to go.
values.feedback: Confirming, rewarding or warning after an action.
values.typography: Type as the primary visual material. (extension)
values.cursor: The pointer itself becomes part of the design. (extension)
values.tooltip: Small contextual labels anchored to something. (extension)
values.feature-section: A section that explains what a product does. (extension)
values.product-showcase: Presenting a physical or digital product as an object. (extension)
values.data-viz: Charts, meters, heatmaps and live numbers. (extension)
values.empty-state: What a view shows when there is nothing in it yet. (extension)
values.character: Mascots, companions and characters with states. (extension)
values.unspecified: Not established from published metadata; inspect the original reference.

dimensions.label: Behavior
dimensions.question: How does it move or respond?

values.still: Does not move; the quality is in composition, texture or type.
values.ambient-loop: Moves continuously on its own, usually slowly.
values.hover: Responds when the pointer rests over it.
values.scroll-driven: Progress is tied to scroll position.
values.drag: Follows a held pointer or finger.
values.swipe: A directional fling with a threshold.
values.hold: Requires a sustained press before it acts.
values.physics: Mass, velocity, friction or collision govern motion.
values.spring: Overshoots and settles like a spring rather than a timed curve.
values.shared-element: The same object travels between two states or views.
values.wipe: A hard edge sweeps across to swap content.
values.parallax: Layers move at different rates to imply depth.
values.orbit: Elements travel on circular or elliptical paths.
values.simulation: A running system: particles, fluids, flocks, cellular rules.
values.state-transition: Animates between discrete states of a component.
values.stagger: A sequence of elements moves with small offsets in time. (extension)
values.distortion: Geometry, text or image is warped, displaced or rippled. (extension)
values.zoom: Scale changes to move between overview and detail. (extension)
values.rotate: Turning, spinning or dialing around an axis. (extension)
values.unspecified: Not established from published metadata; inspect the original reference.

values.load: Plays when the page or component appears.
values.time: Runs on a clock, loop or idle timer.
values.hover: Pointer enters or rests on it.
values.pointer-move: Pointer movement anywhere in its field.
values.click: A tap, click or key activation.
values.unspecified: Not established from published metadata; inspect the original reference.

values.tactile: You want to touch it; it implies a physical surface.
values.mechanical: Clicks, detents, gears and hinges; precise moving parts.
values.soft: Gentle edges, low contrast, unhurried motion.
values.playful: Invites play; rewards poking at it.
values.cinematic: Framed like film: camera moves, light, drama.
values.editorial: Like a well-set magazine or book.
values.organic: Natural, irregular, grown rather than built.
values.dense: Lots of information per square inch, on purpose.
values.luxury: Expensive restraint; material and spacing carry value.
values.precise: Exact alignment and timing; nothing is approximate.
values.unspecified: Not established from published metadata; inspect the original reference.

dimensions.label: Material
dimensions.question: What does it look like it is made of?

values.pixel: Visible pixel grids and low resolution.

values.halftone: Dot screens whose size follows tone.
values.physics-engine: A physics engine such as Rapier, Matter or Cannon. (extension)
values.native: Native mobile animation APIs (React Native, SwiftUI). (extension)

values.infinite-canvas: A pannable, zoomable plane without edges.
values.camera: An implied camera frames or moves through the scene.

dimensions.label: Scale
dimensions.question: How big a piece of work is it?

values.detail: A single visual detail or treatment.
values.page-system: A system that shapes an entire page or site.
values.experience: An immersive, game-like or world-like site.

roles.note: Roles order a combined direction brief. Each record names the role it most naturally plays on a page.
